faq: What is Akash Bhanshali's portfolio worth?
His publicly disclosed holdings were about ₹7,666–8,591 crore across 16–17 stocks after the September 2026 filings, depending on the data source and price date.
What did Akash Bhanshali buy recently?
No new stocks appeared in his September 2026 filings. His only increase was a tiny one in Dilip Buildcon (1.29% to 1.30%).
How much has his Sudarshan Chemical bet made?
He bought 55,67,711 Sudarshan Chemical shares at ₹300.20 on 19 October 2018. At about ₹1,045 in November 2026, that lot was up roughly 248% on paper, an estimated gain of about ₹415 crore.
How do you know the prices?
Prices are exact only for bulk and block deals, which the exchanges publish daily. Quarterly filings show shares held but not the price paid, so those gains are shown as not public or estimated.
